# 1 Clement Chapter 60 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 60 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_060_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 60

*[The Great Prayer — Part II: Intercession for Rulers and All Humanity]*

**60:1** For you have revealed the everlasting fabric of the world through the things you have made. You, LORD, established the earth. You who are faithful throughout all generations, righteous in your judgments, wonderful in power and majesty, wise in creating and discerning in establishing that which is, good in all that is visible and trustworthy among those who trust in you — merciful and compassionate — forgive us our offenses and our unrighteous acts and our transgressions and failures.

**60:2** Do not reckon every sin of your servants and handmaids, but purify us with the purification of your truth and direct our steps to walk in holiness of heart, to do what is good and pleasing before you and before our rulers.

**60:3** Yes, O Lord, let your face shine upon us for good in peace, and let your mighty hand be our shelter, and your uplifted arm deliver us from every sin. Rescue us from those who hate us without cause.

**60:4** Give harmony and peace to us and to all who inhabit the earth, as you gave to our fathers when they called upon you in faith and in truth, that we may be saved as we render obedience to your all-powerful and most excellent name, and to our rulers and governors upon the earth.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with elevated liturgical register for the Great Prayer.*
